text.description_html:
Omnia AP-9450/320-US32D, 14 Inch Refrigerator Pull

This slim stainless steel appliance features a smooth contemporary curve radius for an elegant look. Manufactured by Omnia who has been a leader in Stainless Steel hardware for over 40 years. This contemporary curved appliance door pull is crafted from high grade solid stainless steel. It has an over all length of 14-9/16 inches and a 12-5/8 inch center to center.

Also available Smooth Curve Stainless Cabinet Pulls

Specifications for the Omnia 9450/320-US32D Curved Stainless Steel Appliance Pull:

  • Material: Stainless Steel
  • Finish: Brushed Stainless Steel
  • Pull Diameter: 10 mm (.394") - (Very Slim less than 1/2")
  • Overall Length: 14-9/16"
  • Center to Center Mount: 320 mm (12-5/8")
  • Projection: 1-3/8"
  • Pull Mounting: Standard 3/4" Thick Appliance Panel

Sold Individually
